definitions.explanation: Fibers in the body that transmit signals between the brain and other parts of the body.
One's mental state, sensitivity to things, or disposition.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{神経|しんけい}が{細|こま}かい。
examples.english: He is very sensitive / pays attention to details.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}の{前|まえ}で{話|はな}すと{神経|しんけい}が{高|たか}ぶる。
examples.english: I get nervous when speaking in front of many people.

notes:
{神経|しんけい} is used for both physical nerves and psychological sensitivity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神経|しんけい}が{細|こま}かい (sensitive, detail-oriented)
- {神経|しんけい}が{太|ふと}い (thick-skinned, insensitive - often negative)
- {神経|しんけい}を{使|つか}う (to be nervous, to pay careful attention)
- {神経|しんけい}にさわる (to get on one's nerves)
- {神経|しんけい}が{高|たか}ぶる (nerves are on edge)

COMPOUNDS:
- {神経|しんけい}{質|しつ} (nervous temperament)
- {神経|しんけい}{科|か} (neurology department)
- {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい} (autonomic nervous system)
